summary: Iteration 34 (bulk-resend set-password + routes/applications.py + routes/hours.py extractions): 19/19 NEW backend tests PASS + 25/25 iter33 regression PASS + 6/6 iter32 regression PASS. Live UI verified end-to-end. FEATURE (bulk-resend): POST /api/admin/members/bulk-resend-set-password — member→403, unauth→401, admin with no pending users returns total:0, admin with N pending returns {ok:true, total:N, sent:N, failed:0, skipped_no_email:0, members:[{id,name,email,sent}]}. Double-invocation is idempotent (same total). Per-user resend (back-compat shim) still works: unknown→404, member→403, admin→200 with {ok,sent,email}. REFACTOR (applications): public POST /auth/apply with applicant-chosen password creates pending app; duplicate email→400; admin GET /admin/applications?status_filter=pending lists it; member→403; POST /admin/applications/{id}/review action=approve creates user + sends welcome email + user can immediately log in with applicant-chosen password (verified via real auth/login); already-reviewed app→400; unknown id→404; reject path also returns ok:true and does NOT create a user. REFACTOR (hours): POST /hours (member, status=pending), GET /hours admin-only with status_filter (member→403), PUT /hours/{id}/review flips status + adjusts hours value (sets hours_adjusted_by/_at audit) + edits activity/agency/event_type, AND admin can re-review AFTER approval (flip approved→rejected works), DELETE /hours/{id} (owner or admin), 404 on missing id, GET /me/hours filters by year/quarter/month/status correctly, GET /me/hours/summary returns {year, total_approved, total_pending, by_month:[12], by_quarter:[4]} with correct buckets. Governor (chapter-scoped) GET /hours returns 200 with scoped list. UI: Admin → Members toolbar correctly renders both amber pills when pendingCount>0 — filter-pending-setpw ('6 pending password setup') AND bulk-resend-setpw ('Resend to all 6'). Clicking bulk-resend-setpw fires window.confirm (auto-accepted), POSTs to /api/admin/members/bulk-resend-set-password (status 200, 6 members all sent:true), and refreshes the list.
critical_code_review_comments: Refactor is clean. routes/applications.py (304 lines) owns POST /auth/apply + GET /admin/applications + POST /admin/applications/{id}/review + the 3 Resend email helpers (admin notification, approval welcome, rejection). routes/hours.py (197 lines) owns 6 routes (POST/GET /hours, PUT review, DELETE, GET /me/hours, GET /me/hours/summary) with injected hours_out / is_chapter_scoped / chapter_scope_user_ids / period_to_range / get_current_user / admin_tab_dep — clean dependency injection, no circular imports.

POST /admin/members/bulk-resend-set-password correctly: (1) gates on RESEND_API_KEY → 503, (2) iterates db.users.find({'pending_set_password': True}), (3) for each user invalidates older unused tokens with $set used=true + invalidated_by='bulk-resend', (4) inserts new 7-day token, (5) calls _send_set_password_email shim, (6) returns full summary with per-member sent/skipped/error tracking. The skipped_no_email branch is implemented (rare in practice but defensive).

Applicant approval flow correctly uses the applicant's chosen password_hash from the application doc (line 228 of applications.py). Verified live: applicant set password 'AppPass123!' at /apply, admin approved, applicant immediately logged in with the same password without needing a set-password email. The user doc is created with pending_set_password=False (correct — applicant ALREADY set their password during /apply).

Frontend Admin.jsx bulkResendSetPassword() helper (lines 745-757) correctly: confirms via window.confirm before posting, calls /admin/members/bulk-resend-set-password, distinguishes between fully-successful (toast.success) and partial (toast.warning showing sent/failed/skipped), and calls load() to refresh. The bulk-resend-setpw button is rendered conditionally on pendingCount>0 alongside filter-pending-setpw — both share the amber color family but the bulk button uses solid bg-amber-500/white-text to differentiate from the filter pill (good UX).

Hours model HoursLogIn requires host_name/host_email/host_phone (all min_length validated) — strict but consistent with the broader 'log volunteer hours' UX. Note for next test author: event_type is Literal['aop_related','other'] — using 'volunteer' returns 422. Tests in test_iteration34 use the correct values.

_send_set_password_email back-compat shim at server.py:488-498 remains correctly wired: bulk-import + apply-approval-set-password (n/a since applicant chooses own pwd) + per-user resend + NEW bulk-resend all go through the shim → routes/auth_email_flows.send_set_password_email.

context_for_next_testing_agent: /app/backend/tests/test_iteration34_bulk_resend_applications_hours.py is the new regression suite (19 tests, ~8s). It tolerates REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL being absent from env by reading /app/frontend/.env directly — older iter33/iter32 suites still expect it as an env var (use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=$(grep REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL /app/frontend/.env | cut -d= -f2) pytest …). HoursLogIn requires host_name/host_email/host_phone and event_type ∈ {'aop_related','other'}. Test applicants left behind have email pattern test_applicant_<hex>@clubhaven.app — safe to leave as TEST_ data, or admin can mass-resend/cleanup via the bulk-resend button itself. The /events/{id}/rsvp + /events/{id}/payment/confirm + /transactions/{id}/approve-event-ticket + /checkin/* + /reports/* routes are KNOWN to still be in server.py — not regressions, deferred extraction per agent_to_agent_context_note.
rca of the issue: N/A — all features and refactors working as designed. Initial 4 test failures were test-side bugs (test used event_type='volunteer' which fails Literal validation, and 3 tests omitted required host_* fields). Fixed the tests; production code is correct.
